notice: Hand-made C0 contract examples. They are not NASA data, not measurements, not results and not validated parameters. Every payload carries origin=synthetic_fixture; nothing computed from them may be presented as a NASA result or qualify a model.

fixtures.shows: host-derived research scope: train+validation only, no code execution
episode mapped to a Codex thread, pinned corpus snapshot and release
ordered, gap-free log: search, accepted forecast job, artifact, tool failure, streamed answer
long call accepted with a job handle, nothing assessed yet
technical failure: error envelope, no result, not assessed
a manifest entry the provider no longer serves (geode 404/410): source_gone, never retried
completed execution whose scientific outcome is insufficient evidence
skills_read result: one skill's full text served on demand, tied to the harness bundle digest that covers it
analysis_execute run under gVisor: program, mounted input, budget, exit, kept output and a refused symlink
claims bound to evidence and artifact values; prediction kept apart from observation
research.v2 episode pinned to a harness (bundle digest, runtime build, model, effort)
research.v2 log: step rationale (model explanation only), tool arguments (inline and partial preview), answer_submit, answer.completed
complete answer mixing a corpus-backed claim with background claims (the model's own knowledge: no support, no values, a number in the text left unverified; the host records host_rule / unverifiable)
answer with catalog views (source excerpt, observed vs predicted series with band, conditions matrix, release card) and support checks

what the agent submits: ids only, no support checks; a predicted number bound to its cell (digest, row key, column) instead of a position; the host resolves evidence, artifacts, releases and stated values
answer_submit refusal listing every actionable problem (unknown evidence, kind/support mismatch, unpinned release)
research.v2 usage.reported: a Claude Code per-turn increment (cache reads/writes folded into input, provider-reported cost) and a Codex running thread total
M5 metrics: measured tool latency p50/p95, an unfinished call, per-turn and per-question tokens with cache hit, a priced turn and an unpriced model (never zero)
episode trace of one harness run: event range, tool I/O artifacts, measured usage, price-list cost, partitions touched
/api/v1/capabilities: runtime build manifest, unconfigured services and tools with reasons
hybrid search with filters; no scope in the body
one hit with a PDF region locator; dense backend unavailable (degraded); total unknown
partial read of a page range with the continuation
direct streaming from the provider: signed URL with expiry, Range and CORS
pass-through proxy for a host without CORS; nothing stored
link out only: a page to open, no bytes streamed
sampled keyframe index of an MPEG-TS recording (R11): init section, I-frame ranges, unwrapped PTS
first page of a remote ZIP's entries from its cached central directory (R11)
section tree with page ranges and generated (non-evidence) summaries; a depth cut is flagged
builder bundle (train+validation), Parquet view with SI units and time origin
uncalibrated contours: pixel_only, identity unresolved, not usable as metres
pixel-space contour records of a pixel_only bundle: causal mask, one frame without an edge
evidence.v2 search asking for concise items
two-pass model labels: one agreed and resolved, one disagreement kept as a conflict
labelling batch over a snapshot with counts and a gold-set accuracy
a run's typed neighbours: fuel and hardware seeded from a table, a semantic mention left unresolved
itemized delta (revise, add, remove) against base revision 1
revision 2 after the patch; an item written under validation access keeps that restriction
paged wiki index
web result as an excerpt-only candidate with unverified rights
fetched snapshot with verified rights, promoted into the corpus
conditions matrix with value, missing, conflicting and not-applicable cells, and the tested envelope
toy spec: author-written, structural-zero, physical and fixed tensors
W0 literal patch: box, element and scalar assignments
literal release: not_trained, experimental, manifest bound to tensors
development feedback on validation
accounting with a refused case kept in the denominator; not assessed for qualification
documentary task (LitQA2 format): choices, the right one supported by a locator; insufficient evidence always offered
analytical task: an executable check and expected SI values with a tolerance
citation task: a statement to support, scored on the accepted locators
predictive task: scored only through a frozen evaluator protocol; no answer of its own
frozen dev set of the two tasks, pinned by set_hash
what a builder's harness runner receives from the dev set: questions and choices, no answer keys
harness benchmark: two arms (same runtime, model, effort), two repetitions, cluster by task cluster
harness comparison: every planned run reported (one failed), per-arm scores with cost, paired delta with an interval; not assessed
